digest.component_or_area: test suite timing optimization (review-bot, lock-retry, autodeploy coverage)
propositions: Test-only wall-clock delays in review-bot bootstrap (~10.15s), lock-retry (~15.56s), shutdown (~9s), and autodeploy health-check (~11.25s) consume excessive test runtime without exercising production timeout/retry/drain/health contracts.
Production timeout, retry, drain, and health defaults and boundary behavior must remain unchanged and byte-for-byte identical.
Real subprocess, lock, process-group, and health boundary execution must be retained; only test-owned clocks and passive wait windows are to be shortened.

Focused test suite median reduced from 56.22s to 29.31s (47.9% savings, 26.91s aggregate); each modified family clears 50% reduction while preserving attempt counts, schedules, terminal states, and observability.
All attempt/warning/observable assertions and exact-defect mutation oracles remain valid; retries-disabled, fresh-drain, and episode-reset mutations confirmed RED after optimization.
